description: Run a program with secrets from SEAL links or your inbox in its environment. The values never enter this conversation: they are removed from the output you get back. Use it instead of reading a secret file.

command.description: The program and its arguments, run without a shell.

cwd.description: Working directory of the program; default this server's.

secrets.description: Each one is a link or an inbox item carrying one text file (up to 64 KiB), put into one variable of the program's environment.

item.description: An inbox handle from seal_inbox (`in_…`), instead of a URL.

name.description: The variable; default: the file's name in capitals (`Brave API key` → `BRAVE_API_KEY`).

url.description: Full SEAL share URL including fragment.

timeout.description: Seconds; after them the program is killed.

name: seal_run
title: Run a program with secrets
